steps.title: Initialize Project Manifest
steps.description: Configuring AndroidManifest.xml with activities for gameplay, level select, help, and settings, and routing application launchers.

steps.title: Configure Gradle Build Rules
steps.description: Setting target, compile SDK 34 and min SDK 21 with precise Java 8 compilation compatibility properties.

steps.title: Create Arrow Enum Encoders
steps.description: Formulating ArrowDirection and ArrowState structures to coordinate directions and flight phases dynamically.

steps.title: Create Arrow and Particle Core Components
steps.description: Structuring base models to govern location coords, directional vectors, collision parameters, and visual explosion physics particles.

steps.title: Build Dynamic Theme Palette
steps.description: Setting up Cosmic theme accent values, supporting realtime user preferences for dark/light spacecraft color variations.

steps.title: Develop SharedPreferences Scores Manager
steps.description: Implementing ScoreManager to track unlocked levels (1-10) and save high scores systematically.

steps.title: Formulate Procedural Levels Manager
steps.description: Crafting 10 progressive challenges using structured pseudo-random generation logic with exact coordinates.

steps.title: Implement Precise Collision Engine
steps.description: Creating collision math to calculate overlapping grid vectors and coordinate crash mechanics when intersecting trajectories touch.

steps.title: Construct Game Loop Core Engine
steps.description: Developing GameEngine code which updates spacecraft positions, handles exit boundaries, and raises level completion states.

steps.title: Build Custom Game Canvas Renderer
steps.description: Creating custom GameView utilizing classic Canvas vectors to paint responsive cosmic grids, moving arrows, and particle explosions.

steps.title: Create App Landing and HUD Layouts
steps.description: Designing main screen, playfield UI layout, and instruction dialogs in highly responsive XML structures.

steps.title: Develop Main Dashboard Activity
steps.description: Writing MainActivity to boot settings panels, direct play selection screens, and report top flight metrics.

steps.title: Configure Level and Setup Activities
steps.description: Writing activities for level navigation, detailed pilots instruction manuals, and dynamic gameplay controls.

steps.title: Verify Metadata and Assembly Paths
steps.description: Final check of layout names, manifest actions, theme mappings, and workspace properties.

steps.title: Building Arrow Flow: Crash Course
steps.description: Initiate gradle compilation to package and compile the finished multi-level puzzle arcade game project.
